name: PTCBENCH
description: With the increasing deployment of large language models (LLMs) in affective agents and AI systems, maintaining a consistent and authentic LLM personality becomes critical for user trust and engagement. However, existing work overlooks a fundamental psychological consensus that personality traits are dynamic and context-dependent. To bridge this gap, we introduce PTCBENCH, a systematic benchmark designed to quantify the consistency of LLM personalities under controlled situational contexts.
